es: Recomendar un libro, comentar la motivación de un personaje y responder con matices a una crítica en un club de lectura.

vocabulary.es: con el que uno se identifica

prompt.es: Tom dice que el narrador es omnisciente. ¿Qué pista lo contradice?

choices.text: The narrator reads the thoughts of every character.
The narrator knows more than the characters.
The pronoun I shows that a character tells the story.

feedback.es: I never told anyone muestra a un personaje que cuenta su propia experiencia: primera persona, no omnisciente.

origin.text: «I never told anyone what I had seen that night.»

prompt.es: Escucha y elige cómo expresa Leo su crítica.

choices.text: He suggests it instead of saying it openly.

With a detailed review written at home.

feedback.es: Hinted indica que Leo deja caer la crítica sin decirla directamente.

origin.audio: Leo hinted that the ending was weak, but he never said it directly.

prompt.es: Escribe tu intervención: recomienda la novela, explica un motivo y responde a Tom.

answer.text: I would recommend this novel to anyone who enjoys a gripping mystery. The main character is very relatable, because she makes real mistakes. What surprised me was her motive: she lied to protect her family, which is convincing. I see your point that the plot is predictable, Tom, but to be fair, the characters felt real to me. You also said that the ending felt rushed. I agree that the pace changes in the last chapter; however, I think the short ending fits her decision. Overall, I would recommend reading it, even if you do not love it.
accepted: I would recommend this novel to anyone who enjoys a gripping mystery. The main character is very relatable, because she makes real mistakes. What surprised me was her motive: she lied to protect her family, which is convincing. I see your point that the plot is predictable, Tom, but to be fair, the characters felt real to me. You also said that the ending felt rushed. I agree that the pace changes in the last chapter; however, I think the short ending fits her decision. Overall, I would recommend reading it, even if you do not love it.

I would recommend this novel to anyone who likes a good mystery. The pace is slow at first, but the main character is convincing, and her motive is easy to understand: she wanted to protect her sister. I see your point, Tom, the plot is predictable in some places. To be fair, though, the ending did not feel rushed to me, because it follows her decision. I found the last chapters gripping. In the end, I think it is a novel worth reading, especially for readers who enjoy strong characters.

I recommend reading this novel if you enjoy gripping stories. What I liked most was the main character, who is relatable and convincing. Her motive is clear: she wanted to protect her family. I see your point about the ending, Tom, and I agree that it felt a little rushed. However, the plot was not so predictable for me, because the last chapter surprised me. To be fair, the pace was slow at first, but the story became gripping after the middle.

feedback.es: La intervención completa recomienda con would recommend, explica el motivo del personaje, concede con I see your point y responde con tu razón.

origin.text: Tom: «The plot was predictable and the ending felt rushed.» Escribe 80 a 120 palabras: recomienda el libro, comenta por qué actúa la protagonista (su motivo), concede un punto a Tom y responde con tu razón.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué hecho anterior explica el ambiente del cuento.

choices.text: The storm had closed the doors.
The rain had stopped hours before.
Someone had opened all the windows.

feedback.es: Had opened es el hecho anterior que explica el aire frío y el olor a lluvia.

origin.audio: The house was silent, and the cold air smelled of rain. Somebody had opened every window before the storm.
